Mă cheamă Evie și mă pricep să combin orice. Ținute elegante. Culori. Mâncăruri. Băuturi. Oameni care caută iubirea.

Iar combinațiile mele funcționează de minune. Pentru că sunt o expertă a iubirii și detectez șansa iubirii, înainte ca viitoarea pereche să-și dea seama de ceea ce-i așteaptă.

Într-o zi, însă, la rugămintea unei prietene, accept să lucrez la un caz mai dificil.

Dylan e multimilionar. E atrăgător de-ți sucește mințile. Dar e de o bună credință absolută și de o naivitate care ar fi adorabilă, dacă nu ar fi atât de periculoasă.

Când îl cunosc, descopăr că are ochi frumoși. Urmează o conversație inteligentă. Apoi, privirea îmi alunecă magnetic spre sud. Și îmi pierd șirul cuvintelor.

Și totuși, Dylan e un client. Conduita profesională îmi spune să păstrez distanța.

Dar corpul meu are alte idei...

Review and Excerpt at Of Pens and Pages.

This book is so adorable! It’s the kind of story that will make you grin and fan yourself because of the heat, pretty much like when you eat a delicious taco with the spicy salsa. Yum.



It's impossible not to approve, Mr. Darcy.

A matchmaker extraordinaire and a smart but socially clueless tech multimillionaire walk into a boba tea shop called Quickie, and it’s not a joke. When Evie “Stud Finder” Milligan’s good friend shows her the dating ad her brother posted online, Evie knows it in her heart that she has to help the nerdy hot tech mogul and prove to him she can find his perfect match better than his most trusted worldwide web can.

Dylan Parker is so sure he’ll find his future wife once he posts the ad he wrote himself, but when he receives nothing but questionable proposals from countless women (and men), he gives into his sister’s suggestion to enlist the help of her friend. When he and Evie start working on Dylan to figure out his perfect match, Dylan realizes that Evie isn’t so different from him after all. But how can he convince his matchmaker that the one he wants to be matched with is her?

This novella has a fresh yet familiar writing style that I love and can't get enough of. With Lauren Blakely's signature humor, Stud Finder is a fun, playful read that is seeping with sexual tension and a strong connection between two extremely lovable characters.

I adored both characters, but I have a special place in my heart for Dylan, a man I think is different from the other heroes in the Big Rock world. He’s not as smooth when it comes to dating, but his efforts to win over Evie in his own way made me swoon so much.

It was a delight to read about their non-dates, the ease in their banter, and the palpable chemistry between Evie and Dylan. I had a perma-grin on my face as I read this story, I swear.

And that ending. ❤️❤️❤️ especially the last few paragraphs. Ahhhhh. That’s all I’m going to say. So sweet.

If you’re looking for a quick but incredibly satisfying read that will make you giggle and smile and feel butterflies all over, I recommend reading Stud Finder by Lauren Blakely. If you haven’t read any of her books yet and would like to dip your toes in LB’s writing style, I think this would be a lovely book to start.

And I’m sure Lauren Blakely fans will have a hoot reading this and trying to find the connection between the Stud Finder characters and the rest of the Big Rock world characters.

Now, I'm off to wallow in my cave as I wait for Mia and Patrick's story!



Tropes: Friends to Lovers, Matchmaker
POV: First Person, Dual POV
Standalone: Yes

Stud Finder (novella) by Lauren Blakely ~ 4.5 Stars

Dylan is handsome, rich and successful but socially clueless. He is ready to find the woman of his dreams so he decides to run a dating ad. Evie is Dylan’s sisters BFF and a professional match-maker. She helps countless women find their princes and happily ever after. When Evie gets wind of Dylan’s dating add: “Man seeking woman: Hot, rich, smart, witty, self-made multimillionaire Internet genius seeks classy, intelligent, sexy, fun-loving woman who’s interested in settling down and sharing all the good things.” Evie is not having it - she is determined to use her skills and talents to find the right woman for Dylan. But in order to match Dylan with the right person, Evie has to get to know him better right? Find out his likes, dislikes, what makes him tick … so Evie and Dylan go on several fake dates to practice. Friendship grows, matchmaker/client relationship line blurs … chemistry sizzling … what happens when the match-maker falls for her client?

This is a novella – quick, entertaining read. Sexy, sweet, flirty, funny with adorable nerdy hero and quirky heroine. I have a smile on my face the whole time. Loved it!

***COMING SEPTEMBER 26 - FULL REVIEW***

5 Make Me a Match CROWNS

Novella's are often hard books for me to read, because I often feel that they are underdeveloped or too angst driven for a shorter romance. Lauren Blakely, however, has hit the sweet spot, combining the right balance of steam, chemistry and angst for a perfect romantic match and another must read.

I love a hot nerd, and, boy, oh boy, does Ms. Blakely deliver the goods with Dylan. More than this sexy nerd, readers also get a confident, self-assured man who oozes charm and charisma. I was drawn to his character immediately and could see how Evie could fall for him too. His sense of adventure and his views on what is important in a partner only add to his allure, putting him on the long list of Lauren Blakely heroes I absolutely adore.

Evie is an interesting heroine for me. Often, I find Lauren Blakely to write these sassy and forthright heroines, and Evie is a bit of a departure from the expectation. But guess what? I really enjoyed her character. Her quirky mind and her passion for her career make her endearing, and I love her devotion to finding love, real romance for her clients. It makes the reader want her to find the same, to be matched with her perfect partner.

Stud Finder has absolutely perfect pacing. Even though it is a novella, I truly felt as though Lauren Blakely allows readers to get to know these characters, to appreciate them as individuals before we yearn for them to be more. The development of the chemistry between them lends to the authenticity of their relationship, and the build up only adds to the enjoyment of the story. In true Lauren Blakely fashion, the intimate moments are so steamy, but Dylan and Evie had a sweetness to their intimacy that spoke of a real connection, something more than lust. Absolutely every aspect of her storytelling is spot on!

I also really enjoyed the narrative voice she used to tell this story. The narrator Fairytale opening, interlude, and conclusion are amazing. The tone it set for this novella and how it added a Fairytale-esque quality to Dylan and Evie's romance only added to the long list of reasons I adored this story.

Sweet. Sexy. Absolutely PERFECT! Stud Finder is the quintessential romance. Lauren Blakely has given readers everything we want: unique and lovable characters, sweet and alluring romance, and storytelling that ensnares readers from page one. She has, yet again, crafted another must read love story!

4 'Getting matched' Stars!


The perfect quick read for a weekday afternoon, of course, this was another winner by Lauren Blakely! I love what she is able to present to her readers in such a short format: great profound characters, an entertaining storyline and a couple that melts you with their sweetness!

Stud Finder is a 1001 Dark Nights standalone novella but it can be considered part of Lauren's Big Rock world. It tells the love story between a hot nerdy businessman (Dylan) looking for the love of his life and a sassy matchmaker (Evie) that is decided to not fall in love with her newest client. Let's just say both of them fail miserably on that!

The women all sound great. I bet they’re fantastic ladies.
But I don’t want to date them.
What I want to do is convince Evie to date me.

This short story was pure sweetness! Evie and Dylan start as matchmaker and client but everything starts to blur when they start REALLY liking each other. The connection between these two is amazing from their very first meeting and it gets even better when both accept their feelings for each other (that sweetness gets hot too!!). I really enjoyed reading Stud Finder!

Somehow, some way, this handsome pain-in-the-butt man has worked his way into my heart.

“I want you to match me with you.”

Therefore, I am rating this short story with 4 STARS because it was a quick read that provided everything I love in romance novellas and in Lauren's style.. even better! Lauren Blakely never fails me. Check this one out if you love her other stories!

Lauren Blakely once again charms her readers with Stud Finder. In this fast paced and utterly entertaining novella, Blakely serves up a love story that was smart, funny, sweet, and sassy. After a failed attempt at an ad looking for a woman, Dylan’s sister suggest that he try the matchmaking service she had used that is owned by her friend, Evie. Right away, Blakely sets up a charming love story of what else: A man in need of matchmaking and a woman who is a professional matchmaker. So as Dylan and Evie begin to spend more time together, it was bound for their friends to see that these two belong together as they are very compatible with one another. So will Dylan and Evie realize that they are the perfect match? Or will their friends have to do the matchmaking?

The perfect little romance package...

Stud Finder was short and sweet but definitely gave me the hit I needed to get me through my day. I think the magic ingredient in this one was the fact that the hero was looking for a relationship. All too often, our hero is looking for a hookup or someone to distract for a little while. In this case, Dylan is ready to settle down and looking for his perfect match. His first attempt is to go with an ad explaining exactly what he wants. Unfortunately, he mentions that he's hot and rich which of course gets him A LOT of attention...of the money hungry, desperate kind. Time to bring in the big guns...THE MATCHMAKER!!!

Evie is a very talented matchmaker and happily takes on the job of finding Dylan his perfect match. To find his perfect woman, she must study and get to know him. In her studies, she stumbles across a problem...Dylan is HER perfect match.

It doesn't take long for this couple to realise they're perfect for each other. Evie is a little worried about ruining her friendship and reputation by falling for one of her clients. Dylan must use all his skills to make sure the matchmaker does her job properly. He will only be happy with his perfect match...THE STUD FINDER!

The narrators do a pretty good job with this one. Unfortunately, I do struggle a little with Grace Grant's male voice. She tends to slow her talking voice down making him sound stilted and stuffy. It wouldn't stop me from listening to her again, but she's not my favourite.

I really enjoyed this short, steamy and entertaining little treat. I can't wait for Mia and Patrick's (I think that's their names, I have a shocking memory) story.

4.5 stars

If you follow my reviews, you know that I’ve read more than my fair share of mediocre novellas. Stud Finder proves that yes, Virginia, there are excellent ones out there. This is the second novella I’ve read and enjoyed by Lauren Blakely, and I think she should give a master class in the art of writing novellas. This book may be short, but it packs one heck of a lively punch.

I adored Evie and Dylan. They are both developed, fun-loving characters. In some ways they are opposites, but also well suited. Blessedly, the story manages to avoid the common pitfall of insta-lust. Evie and Dylan’s initial attraction to one another is platonic and based on their carefree, genuinely kind personalities. As their friendship grows, so does the sexual chemistry. The result is a pleasurable slow burn that is perfectly paced.

I’m normally a fan of epilogues, but I could have done without the last chapter—which reads like an epilogue—and the actual epilogue(s). I found them to be on the cheesy side, and the story feels complete and very satisfying without them.

Stud Finder is lighthearted, flirty, and exceptionally entertaining. If you’re looking for a charming diversion, this book has you covered.

Recommended for fans of:
Matchmakers
Romantic comedy
Yoga
Bubble tea

4.5 Perfect Match Stars

OMG! This book is too stinking cute! I adored it. Another fantastic read from Lauren Blakely.



So... novellas are my jam and this one is very close to perfect! The characters are amazing, the storyline is perfection, the writing is exceptional, and last but not least it was sweet and sexy.

Here's the breakdown: Dylan is ready to settle down and find the woman of his dreams. Evie hires herself out to find Dylan the woman of his dreams, as a favor to his sister. When they meet each other again over tea, the attraction is undeniable. But Evie follows the unspoken match-maker code and refuses to date from the pool of potential clients. What happens when you're hired to find another woman for your perfect match?

What I loved: The characters are fabulous. They're both interesting and engaging. I absolutely loved Dylan's character. He's so quirky and cute. Seriously, nerdy perfection. Both Dylan and Evie have their quirks, but they're self assured and no nonsense. They know what they want and pursue it. No games; no jumping through hoop. Just straight forward, sexy, sweet romance.
It's not always a guarantee that a novella will deliver a story that feels fully developed in a shorter span of time. This one doesn't suffer from that problem. Ms. Blakely does a superb job at fleshing out characters and providing enough action to make the novella feel longer than it actually was. The story is complete and completely entertaining.

Overall, this is a huge win! Nearly perfect in every way! I highly recommend it. 1-click asap!

The cover copy tells you where this stands in relation to other books. It works fine if you haven't read those, though, because it's pretty well self-contained.

I enjoyed this. It's a simple story that's about as long as it needed to be. Dylan is a charming fantasy of a rich, successful dork looking for someone to connect long-term with. Evie steps in when his initial attempt is delightfully clueless. Too clueless, really, because he's supposedly an online genius but doesn't know that people are notoriously disingenuous on matchmaking services. Going with the fantasy, these are delightful characters. Their shared love of the quirky parts of the city and sharing their insights both with each other and in pithy formats online was fun and I totally bought their connection.

The fantasy is too threadbare for five stars and there's a late-story pullback that felt unnecessary making the rating wobbly, but in all I was engaged and enjoyed my time with the characters.

“I want you to match me with you.”

I'm pretty sure I look like a fool right about now, with a grin spread a mile wide on my face. This book was EVERYTHING. It was all kinds of sweet and delicious like that boba tea Dylan and Evie had at Quickie, hot and sweat-inducing like the spicy as hell salsa that Evie savored all too much at Mama une's, but most of all, it was perfect, precious and absolutely magical. Only Lauren Blakely can make me feel this way even after reading a quick novella. Stud Finder is tremendously, out of this world satisfying. The ultimate rom com that will leave you with loads of good vibes and swoony feels that lasts for days. It's the brilliantly concocted tale you never knew you needed.

Did someone say hot nerd? Because... YES PLEASE! No questions asked, no explanations needed. Honestly, Dylan Parker is the kind of guy I'd definitely be interested to date IRL. I just loved how socially clueless he was. It wasn't the kind that would leave you feeling awkward; instead, it was so adorable considering how sexy and witty he was. Dylan's intelligence—the way his mind works—was utterly refreshing. The way he described and just knew what he wanted in a woman who he'll be spending the rest of his life with will completely melt your heart (and panties). He's definitely a far cry from the more superficial men you read about or hear about these days. This guy? He's persistent as hell and deep af, considering the things and activities he wants to do with the woman he'll be matched with. And his sense of humor? On. Freaking. Point. I just soaked up all that charming, bordering on dirty humor like a sponge on steroids. Dylan Parker left butterflies fluttering—no, swarming—in my stomach even long after I was done reading.

Evie Milligan is extraordinarily gifted with the talent of having a keen eye for matching anything—colors, clothes, food and the best yet—soulmates. She was so good at it that she even turned in into a business. But she was the matchmaker who hasn't come across her own match yet. Little did she know, it'll be her next client who would capture her heart and full attention. I loved Evie's quirkiness. She was so desirable, so ridiculous and fun. Her stories and her personality beyond entertained me and had me laughing more than I expected. Once you get to know her, it wouldn't be the least bit surprising why Dylan chose her. Why after just a few get togethers, their chemistry was already off the charts. Or why they worked and got along so well with each other despite their numerous differences. They were really just a match made in heaven.

If you're looking for an EPIC, endlessly swoon-worthy and toe-curling romantic comedy—one with the sweetest, sexiest moments and some of the most hilarious lines and scenes you'll ever read and picture in your head while busting your gut laughing, do yourself a favor and pick up any of Lauren Blakely's romcoms. You can never ever go wrong there. Trust me. And make sure to add this book about the hot nerd and the matchmaker to that list of must reads, because this Stud Finder will not let you down.

Reviewed on behalf of The Book Boyfriend Addict (www.bookboyfriendaddict.com). A complimentary copy was provided in exchange for an honest review.

4.5 Stars

I know I have to help him. I simply can’t let a man who’s that much of a catch take this sort of risk.

I seriously love Lauren Blakely so much, her books never fail to leave me grinning from ear to ear and falling in love right along with her characters! This may be a novella, but make no mistake, this one is full of everything we’ve come to love about Lauren Blakely’s books – incredibly down-to-earth, relatable characters, tons of swoon, smart and flirty banter, and plenty of heat! Stud Finder can absolutely be read as a standalone but if you’ve read some of her past offerings in this interconnected world of standalones, then you’ll definitely recognize some familiar faces throughout the story. I love how interconnected all of these characters are, this world just keeps growing and growing and I hope it never stops! (As a side note, I thought the character charts at the end were genius! I was thinking as I was reading that I wish there was some sort of list because sometimes it’s hard to remember the connections, but my wish was granted when I got to the end!)

This particular book is about Dylan Parker who is a tech whiz and uber-successful entrepreneur, he’s attractive and very down-to-earth but he’s a little awkward when it comes to social situations. He’s looking for a woman who he can share his interests and time with but when his attempt at putting an ad up on an online dating site backfires he agrees to use the matchmaker who his sister used to find her fiancé. Evie knows what a catch Dylan is and she is eager to help him find the perfect woman. As the two, seemingly opposites, spend time together so Evie can assess what Dylan is looking for, they begin to realize they had more in common than they ever thought. Their attraction quickly grows and Dylan is pretty sure that the perfect woman for him is the one right in front of him, but will Evie break the cardinal rule of matchmaking and fall for her client?

Stud Finder is a really quick read but it never felt rushed or forced. I loved seeing Dylan and Evie get to know one another and see them slowly start to fall for each other. Their banter was spot on and I found myself chuckling more often than not at their conversations. Dylan was delightfully awkward and so charming, I loved him! For being so successful, he was so wonderfully normal and really came across as your everyday kind of guy and I loved that. It’s something that I love about all of Lauren Blakely’s characters, they are totally people you can picture yourself being friends with. It’s such fun to read! Evie was great, I loved her perceptive nature and her competitive yoga skills! The chemistry between Dylan and Evie was perfect and I loved all the sexual tension that resulted in a really great payoff! I also really enjoyed the little addition of the prologue, interlude, and epilogue, it was a fun little twist that perfectly capped off the story! A must-read for all Lauren Blakely fans or for anyone looking for a quick, funny, and sexy read!
